Class SystemJoinLobbyCommand

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.controller.command.SystemJoinCommand
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.controller.command.SystemJoinLobbyCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
QueuedCommand
public class SystemJoinLobbyCommand extends SystemJoinCommand
Internal queue command used by the pre-lobby controller to ask a lobby controller to enroll an authenticated session with the totem color selected by that player.

This command is specific to lobby joins because, unlike generic game reconnect joins, entering a lobby must also reserve a totem color before the match can start.
